fact: A Université de Sherbrooke poster for ACFAS 2024 states that the SanDi project (2021-2022) deployed digital health tools (tablets, computers, smart glasses and the OpenClinic software) in 27 community health centres (CSCom), and that the ApproTech study (2023-2025) of their uptake covered 27 centres in five regions (15 community centres, 7 university centres and 5 reference centres), where interviewed CSCom staff describe the tool as giving them a patient record; no denominator is given.
title: L'appropriation des outils de santé numérique par les professionnel.le.s de la santé au Mali: protocole de recherche et résultats préliminaires
publisher: Centre interdisciplinaire de développement international en santé (CIDIS), Université de Sherbrooke
